data.name: entries_facts_immutable
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER entries_facts_immutable
  BEFORE UPDATE OF entry_id, root_id, version, supersedes_entry_id, entry_type, lot_id, plot_id, farmer_id,
    instance_no, payload_json, device_time, gps_time, lat, lng, accuracy_m, location_status, entered_by_user_id,
    assist_mode, entered_remotely, reason_code, undo_deadline, created_at
  ON entries
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'entries are append-only: save a new version instead');
END;

data.name: entries_no_delete

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entries" ("entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "root_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "supersedes_entry_id" TEXT NULL, "entry_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "lot_id" TEXT NULL, "plot_id" TEXT NULL, "farmer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "instance_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "gps_time" TEXT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "lat" REAL NULL, "lng" REAL NULL, "accuracy_m" REAL NULL, "location_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "assist_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("assist_mode" IN (0, 1)), "entered_remotely" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("entered_remotely" IN (0, 1)), "reason_code" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "undo_deadline" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entry_id"));

CREATE TRIGGER entries_facts_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF entry_id, root_id, version, supersedes_entry_id, entry_type, lot_id, plot_id, farmer_id, instance_no, payload_json, device_time, gps_time, lat, lng, accuracy_m, location_status, entered_by_user_id, assist_mode, entered_remotely, reason_code, undo_deadline, created_at ON entries BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'entries are append-only: save a new version instead');END
CREATE TRIGGER entries_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON entries BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'entries are append-only: they are never deleted');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media" ("media_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entries (entry_id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height" INTEGER NOT NULL, "captured_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NULL, "lng" REAL NULL, "accuracy_m" REAL NULL, "upload_url" TEXT NULL, "upload_url_expires_at" TEXT NULL, "upload_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "object_key" TEXT NULL, "thumb_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "purged_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("media_id"));
CREATE INDEX entries_lot_status ON entries (lot_id, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX entries_root_version ON entries (root_id, version)
CREATE INDEX media_entry ON media (entry_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "fpo_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "access_token" TEXT NOT NULL, "refresh_token" TEXT NOT NULL, "pin_hash" TEXT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ta', "wifi_only_photos" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("wifi_only_photos" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "farmers" ("farmer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fpo_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "village" TEXT NOT NULL, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "has_smartphone" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("has_smartphone" IN (0, 1)), "language" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("farmer_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plots" ("plot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "farmer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pin_lat" REAL NOT NULL, "pin_lng" REAL NOT NULL, "pin_accuracy_m" REAL NOT NULL, "pin_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "declared_area" REAL NOT NULL, "area_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "survey_no_local_only" TEXT NULL, "boundary_geo_json" TEXT NULL, "gi_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "locked" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("locked" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plot_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lots" ("lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "farmer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "crop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "season" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "kg_harvested" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "kg_packed" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "last_moisture" REAL NULL, "qr_payload" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("lot_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'waiting', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ref_bundles" ("bundle_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "etag" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "body_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_dir" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("bundle_type"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_metrics" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "saved_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "acked_at" TEXT NULL, "photo_upload_ms" INTEGER NULL, "failures" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "network_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "shipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("shipped" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "farmer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lot_id" TEXT NULL, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "prompt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("task_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flags" ("flag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "farmer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NULL, "plot_id" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "severity" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "detail_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolved_reason" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("flag_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "instruments" ("instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "calibration_due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("instrument_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "field_config" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity"));
CREATE INDEX outbox_status_next ON outbox (status, next_attempt_at)
